column1: # Live smoke cases for scripts/live/run.sh. Tab-separated: name, mode, expect, kind, text.
#   mode:   default | bypass   (Claude Code --permission-mode default or bypassPermissions)
#   expect: runs      the tool call must execute (no stub hit needed for builtin tools)
#           blocked   the stub must NOT log this command, and (cmd cases) the hooks replayed
#                     directly must ask or deny it
#           redacted  the session transcript must not contain the fake secret value
#           kept      the untracked .env must still exist afterwards
#   kind:   cmd    text is a shell command; the prompt asks Claude to run it verbatim
#           prompt text is the whole prompt
# The stubs log to $WORK/executed.log, so "blocked" is decided by what actually ran.

column5: Read README.md and reply with its first heading only.
